title: Google SERP Scraper Input

queries.title: Search Queries
queries.description: Use this field when the user provides keywords or search terms. Enter one or more queries — each is scraped separately, one result record per page. Do NOT use this when the user provides a direct Google search URL — use startUrls for that.
queries.sectionCaption: Input — Search Queries or Direct URLs
queries.sectionDescription: Provide keyword queries, direct Google Search URLs, or both. At least one input is required.

startUrls.title: Direct Google Search URLs
startUrls.description: Use this field when the user provides a specific Google search URL (e.g. https://www.google.com/search?q=...). Country/language settings are embedded in the URL itself. Do NOT use this for plain keyword queries — use queries instead.

maxResultsPages.title: Max Result Pages Per Query
maxResultsPages.description: How many pages of Google results to scrape per query. Each page = 10 organic results (default). 1 = positions 1–10, 3 = positions 1–30, 10 = positions 1–100. Each page = 1 billing event.
maxResultsPages.sectionDescription: Control how many results to extract per query.

resultsPerPage.title: Results Per Page
resultsPerPage.description: Number of organic results per page. Google default is 10. Increase for more results per billing event (up to 100). Recommended values: 10, 20, 30, 50, 100.

countryCode.title: Country Code (gl)
countryCode.description: Google country targeting. Controls which regional Google index is queried. Examples: US, GB, DE, FR, AU, CA, IN, BR, JP, MX. Leave empty for global results.
countryCode.sectionDescription: Target specific countries and languages for geo-specific SERP data.

languageCode.title: Language Code (hl)
languageCode.description: Google interface and results language. Examples: en, es, de, fr, pt, ja, zh-CN, ar, ru. Controls Google UI language and biases results toward that language.

includeAds.title: Extract Ad Results
includeAds.description: Extract paid Google Ads appearing at the top and bottom of results pages. Results stored in the ad_results array field.
includeAds.sectionDescription: Choose which SERP elements to include in the output.

includeFeaturedSnippet.title: Extract Featured Snippet
includeFeaturedSnippet.description: Extract the featured snippet (answer box / Position 0) when present on the SERP. Stored in the featured_snippet field.

includePeopleAlsoAsk.title: Extract People Also Ask
includePeopleAlsoAsk.description: Extract the 'People Also Ask' questions section. Useful for content research, FAQ generation, and topic clustering. Stored in the people_also_ask array.

includeRelatedSearches.title: Extract Related Searches
includeRelatedSearches.description: Extract related search suggestions from the bottom of the SERP. Excellent for keyword research and topic mapping. Stored in the related_searches array.

includeKnowledgeGraph.title: Extract Knowledge Graph
includeKnowledgeGraph.description: Extract the Knowledge Graph panel (entity info box) when present. Contains entity title, type, description, and official website. Stored in the knowledge_graph field.

maxConcurrency.title: Max Concurrent Requests
maxConcurrency.description: Number of parallel requests sent to Google. Recommended: 5 for standard use, 2–3 if experiencing blocks. Use only permitted direct/public or licensed API access verified against the actual build. Stop on access denial or rate limits; see the source access gate.
maxConcurrency.sectionDescription: Advanced performance tuning. Default settings work well for most use cases.

x-vibeleads-execution-review: required; schema inspection is not execution permission
